title: 面向LLM智能体的分层协作记忆与有效性感知检索框架HiCoMER
summary: 针对团队协作中记忆异构且持续演化的问题，提出HiCoMER框架，通过分层记忆冲突更新、有效性感知检索和记忆锚定答案生成，避免检索过时或冲突记忆，提升LLM智能体问答质量。
summary_en: HiCoMER is a framework for hierarchical collaborative memory management and validity-aware retrieval in LLM agents. It maintains validity of team and individual memories, retrieves only valid ones via a Hierarchical Memory Conflict Updater, Validity-Aware Memory Retriever, and Memory-Grounded Answer Generator, reducing outdated retrieval and improving QA quality.
